notes.title: Update Coming
notes.content:
Working on an update/fix for the game
Update will include:
-Change in anomaly chance
-4 more anomaly hallways so its an even 16 split between both directions
-Anomaly counter to show how many you've seen
-Achievements
-Controller support
-fix the ending a little and add an exit sign
-Help menu to explain the game ingame incase you don't read the store page
